title: cross-team-engineering-leadership-weekly-staff-notes-2026-08-03
content:
Date: 2026-08-03
Time: 10:00 - 11:00 PT
Location: Zoom + #eng-leadership
Facilitator: Jordan Patel
Note taker: Ariel Kim
Attendees: Jordan Patel, Ariel Kim, Sofia Martinez, David Chen, Priya Rao, Ethan Walker, Maya Singh, Tom Lawson (SRE), Claire Wu (Platform)
body:
Purpose:
  Weekly cross-team sync to align on production health, launches, cross-team dependencies, and prioritized action items for the coming week.

Agenda:
  1) Quick rundowns (30m)  each team: top 2 wins, top 2 risks/blocks
  2) Rollout & canary updates (10m)  Dedicated model variant routing changes
  3) Incident follow-ups & reliability targets (10m)  KV cache miss rate
  4) Action items & next steps (10m)

Notes / Team updates:

Serving Runtime (Jordan / eng-serving-runtime):
  - Wins:
    - Latency improvements: kernel selection changes shipped to canary reduced P95 for long-context runs by ~18% on A100s (perf bench run 2026-07-30).
    - Continuous batching prototype reached target throughput in load test (1.2x baseline) for chat workload.
  - Risks / Blocks:
    - Memory fragmentation observed in long-lived worker pods under heavy multi-tenant workloads (root cause investigation ongoing).
    - Need a stable reproducer for an intermittent OOM in the kv-cache path; impacts Dedicated customers with heavy prefix caching.
  - Requests for other teams:
    - SRE: help correlate node-level memory trends with GC/kern logs (Tom assigned).
    - Release: schedule a short canary window for the memory-fix patch next week.

Platform Engineering (Claire / platform-engineering):
  - Wins:
    - Automated infra provisioning now supports per-tenant GPU type constraints (g4dn, a10g, a100)  landed in infra repo.
    - New Terraform module stub for private deployment bootstrap completed.
  - Risks / Blocks:
    - Cloud quota requests for a10g in us-west-2 delayed; could limit Dedicated capacity for an upcoming customer proof-of-concept.
  - Requests:
    - Go-to-market: provide expected dates for capacity availability so sales can set customer expectations.

Observability (Sofia / observability):
  - Wins:
    - Token-level cost dashboard shipped; early feedback indicates teams appreciate per-route breakdowns.
    - KV cache miss rate dashboard (heatmap) is live for canary cluster.
  - Risks / Blocks:
    - Trace sampling rate currently too low for multi-tenant latency debugging; plan to increase sampling to 5% for a short window during canary runs.
  - Requests:
    - Serving: add a short-lived high-sampling flag for the next canary to capture traces for the OOM repro attempts.

Release Engineering (Ethan / release-engineering):
  - Wins:
    - Canary orchestration for model variant rollouts is now integrated with the console A/B UI.
    - Release checklist updated to include per-tenant quota verification steps.
  - Risks / Blocks:
    - Manual steps remain for fallback policies when a model variant becomes unhealthy; need automation to avoid manual interventions at 3am.
  - Requests:
    - Eng-serving-runtime: provide a clear health signal around memory and kv-cache so release automation can trigger rollbacks reliably.

Private Deployments / Security & Compliance (Priya / private-deployments):
  - Wins:
    - Completed integration tests for KMS rotation flow in VPC mode (internal test suite).
    - Customer pilot for on-prem package scheduled for Aug 18.
  - Risks / Blocks:
    - Documentation gaps for air-gapped installation remain; on-prem onboarding may take longer without step-by-step guides.
  - Requests:
    - Docs team: prioritize detailed install playbook for the top 3 enterprise customers in pilot.

Site Reliability (Tom / sre):
  - Wins:
    - Reduced noisy alerts by tuning RPS anomaly thresholds; paging reduced by ~22%.
    - Root cause analysis for last week's degraded throughput event (ticket JIRA-ENG-1409) completed; primary factor was a regression in batching heuristics.
  - Risks / Blocks:
    - On-call rotation has gaps for the 2nd week of Aug (vacation overlap); need temporary coverage.
  - Requests:
    - Teams: flag any extended planned maintenance windows so SRE can coordinate on-call coverage.

Action items / Owners (summary):
  - Jordan / Serving Runtime: continue memory fragmentation investigation; provide reproducer or detailed telemetry by 2026-08-06.
  - Tom / SRE: correlate node-level metrics with serving logs and share findings (JIRA-ENG-1431) by 2026-08-05.
  - Claire / Platform: follow up on quota request for a10g in us-west-2 and report ETA to GTM by 2026-08-07.
  - Sofia / Observability: enable 5% sampling for canary cluster during next canary (2026-08-05 window) and provide traces to serving team.
  - Ethan / Release: prototype an automated rollback trigger that considers memory and kv-cache health signals; demo by 2026-08-12.
  - Priya / Private Deployments: draft air-gapped installation playbook (v0.1) and share with docs by 2026-08-10.
  - Ariel / Notes & follow-ups: collate action items into Confluence page and link JIRA tickets by EOD 2026-08-04.

Risks & mitigation (cross-team):
  - Risk: Memory fragmentation / OOMs during high prefix-caching usage could impact Dedicated customers.
    - Mitigation: short-term: limit prefix cache size per tenant in canary; medium-term: memory allocator and fragmentation fixes in runtime.
  - Risk: Cloud quota delays for a10g may slow Dedicated capacity expansion.
    - Mitigation: prioritize fallback to other GPU types for early POCs; communicate ETA to sales and customers.

Decisions made:
  - Increase trace sampling to 5% on canary cluster during next canary window (approved).
  - Hold broad rollout of the new batching heuristics until memory fragmentation repro is resolved.

Open questions / parking lot:
  - Do we want an explicit SLA for kv-cache hit-rate? (parking for product discussion next week)
  - Should we formalize a per-tenant resource quota dashboard in the console? (Claire to propose next meeting)

Next meeting:
  - 2026-08-10 10:00 PT (same location)

Attachments / links referenced during meeting:
  - Perf bench: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/long-context-results-2026-07-30
  - RCA: confluence/ENG-RCA/degraded-throughput-2026-07-27
  - Canary plan: confluence/rollouts/2026-q3-canary-plan

Extra notes / freeform (notes to self style):
  - Jordan: remember to sync with Sales and Solutions Eng on Aug 4 re: Dedicated commitments for POC customers.
  - Ariel: follow up with docs on installation playbook priority -- Priya will set scope.
  - Team: consider a short focused summit (2 hours) to tackle memory fragmentation with allocator experts (internal + external contractor)  propose dates in next update.

Recorded by: Ariel Kim
Reviewed and approved: Jordan Patel

End of notes.
